text:
It absolutely is driver issues. Intel's dedicated GPUs were not built from the ground up, but derived from their earlier integrated ancestors. To this end, only one or two CPU threads was responsible for sending requests and handling data between GPU and CPU. That was fine because nobody gamed on these GPUs, and any CPU-GPU latency paled in comparison to (V)RAM latency.

Dedicated GPUs inherited this driver philosophy, which puts a lot of pressure on one, two CPU threads at most, to handle the communication with the GPU. It's a huge bottleneck on driver level.
